attributes.content:
**EL-HAZ-1.1 Report hazard button and turn stalk as raw states**

SCCM_Lighting shall send the current state of the hazard warning button (HazardLightButton: 0 released, 1 pressed) and of the turn stalk (TurnStalk.TurnSignal: 0 neutral, 1 left, 2 right) in every 50 ms cycle on DriverCan0.

It shall not latch, toggle or otherwise interpret these inputs.

description: Obligation of SCCM_Lighting as LightingRequestSensing in ExteriorLightingDesign (EL-HAZ-1.1).

Realized by ImplementedSCCM_Lighting: the MappingModel copies the evdev button and stalk values unchanged (lookup transforms only) to the HazardLightButton and TurnStalk restbus frames, which driver_can.dbc sends every 50 ms.
